p: of his mouth: If he uses his tongue to God's glory, and the profit of his neighbour, God will bless him.
desireth: He always desires, but takes no pains to get anything.
heareth not rebuke: For his poverty, he is not able to escape the threatenings, which the cruel oppressors use against him.
cometh contention: When as every man contends to have preeminence, and will not give place to another.
Wealth gotten by vanity shall be: That is, goods evil gotten.
by labour shall increase: That is, with his own labour.
the word shall be destroyed: Meaning the word of God, by which he is admonished of his duty.
into mischief: Brings many inconveniences both to himself and to others.
destroyed: As he is partaker of their wickedness, and bears with their vices, so will he be punished alike as they are.
wealth of the sinner is laid: Read Job 27:16,17.
poor: God blesses the labour of the poor, and consumes their goods who are negligent, because they think they have enough.
